MOYA Animal Rescues shares powerful, emotional stories about the rescue of abandoned, injured, or endangered animals in nature. Our content is built on original storytelling, creative visual techniques, and a strong commitment to animal protection and public education.

🎯 Our Mission:
To raise awareness about animal welfare, inspire compassionate action, and encourage responsible behavior when encountering animals in need.

📌 Important Note:
All stories are fictional recreations based on real-world scenarios, produced to deliver positive and educational messages. No real animals were harmed or used in the making of these videos.

Subscribe to support our mission – every view helps spread compassion and care for wildlife.

Fanpage: https://www.facebook.com/moyaanimalresucues/
